articles.title: Kraken parent Payward delays IPO to second quarter of 2027 at earliest
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange operator, which confidentially filed for a U.S. listing last November, had already put its IPO plans on hold amid difficult market conditions.

articles.title: New Jersey becomes first state to ask Supreme Court to weigh in on prediction markets
articles.snippet: After multiple appeals courts ruled differently about whether states can crack down on prediction markets' sports products, New Jersey asked SCOTUS to step in.

articles.title: Lawsuit challenges Tether for allegedly freezing $42.4 million USDT before U.S. warrant
articles.snippet: The plaintiffs allege that Tether acted in response to an informal U.S. law-enforcement request more than three months before a seizure warrant was issued.

articles.title: A China indicator that supports risk-taking in stocks and bitcoin is flashing red
articles.snippet: China's "credit impulse" is flashing red for risk assets. So far, bitcoin has mostly shrugged it off.

articles.title: Solana, ether, xrp lead majors slide as Iran strikes drive a broad risk selloff
articles.snippet: Every large-cap token fell over the past 24 hours, and the high-beta majors gave up roughly triple what bitcoin did.
